_doc: The application evaluator runs each case as a baseline/no-skill arm and a with-skill arm, then grades behavior against expected_flags, expected_fix_hints, absent_signals, and the per-case criteria checklist.
subject: Blue Ocean Strategy for market-creating strategy work: diagnose the current value curve, reconstruct market…

cases.scenario: A user asks: "apply Blue Ocean Strategy to this crowded market"
cases.context: The agent has access to the blue-ocean-strategy skill and must decide whether to use it, apply its procedure, and stay inside its boundaries.
cases.question: What should the agent do, and why is blue-ocean-strategy the right skill to apply?
expected_flags: Recognizes blue-ocean-strategy as applicable to this request
Uses the skill-specific purpose or mental model instead of generic advice
Names the relevant boundary against framework-fit-analysis, constraint-awareness, playing-to-win
Turns the request into concrete steps, checks, or decisions from the skill
expected_fix_hints: Apply the blue-ocean-strategy workflow to the concrete scenario
State the next action and the evidence or verification needed
Call out any adjacent skill that should own a different part of the request
absent_signals: Does not answer with generic advice that could ignore blue-ocean-strategy
Does not route to framework-fit-analysis, constraint-awareness, playing-to-win when the blue-ocean-strategy scope is the owner
Does not invent certification, freshness, or runtime success claims without evidence
